description: Comparison of saved train_noisy_mlp_ensemble.py test_outputs.csv.gz logits against the first-order perturbative analytical model in noise_models.py.

empirical_estimator.mean: For each noise_dataset_index, average logits over all selected init/model rows; then average those per-noise means with equal weight across noise datasets.
empirical_estimator.variance: variance_mlp_ensemble is the population variance across the per-noise mean logits. The flat variance over individual model rows is also saved in comparison_arrays.npz as empirical_flat_model_variance for diagnostics.

centering.description: For the centered mean comparison, subtract the mean across classes from each test point's logit vector.

simple_delta_fit_centered.formula: output = a * Delta E^i_alpha[<x_* x_alpha>] + b
simple_delta_fit_centered.target: nested empirical ensemble mean logits after class centering
simple_delta_fit_centered.feature: Delta E^i_alpha[<x_* x_alpha>] = C/N sum_alpha y_alpha,i <x_* x_alpha> - 1/N sum_alpha <x_* x_alpha>, then class-centered before fitting

simple_delta_fit_raw.formula: output = a * Delta E^i_alpha[<x_* x_alpha>] + b
simple_delta_fit_raw.target: raw nested empirical ensemble mean logits
simple_delta_fit_raw.feature: Delta E^i_alpha[<x_* x_alpha>] = C/N sum_alpha y_alpha,i <x_* x_alpha> - 1/N sum_alpha <x_* x_alpha>, without class centering
